paragraphs: Mentioned in Moed Katan 11a: "Rav happened to come to the house of Rav Shafir"; Dikdukei Soferim reads "Bar Shafir."[^1]

notes.text: יא. gives Moed Katan 11a under the period convention. ובדק״ס גרס is read as Dikdukei Soferim reads; Bar Shafir versus Rav Shafir remains Hyman’s attributed variant, without fresh collation or printed-correction history. The source quotation and locator are not independently verified here. All three separate Rav occurrences are full; Bar in the variant is retained as Bar, not title Rav.
